sentences.text: Nambalia is a basal sauropodomorph dinosaur, a member of the larger group Saurischia.
Fossils were found in the Upper Maleri Formation near Nambal village. Fernando E. Novas and colleagues named the species Nambalia roychowdhurii in 2011.
This animal lived in what is now Telangana, central India, between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago.
